observations.title: Catch a fall with a pickaxe
observations.player_action: Right-click a nearby wall with a pickaxe while falling.
observations.outcome: Hard surfaces reduce downward motion toward a hang; softer surfaces allow a slowing slide.
conditions: The source's protection/damage claims are version-dependent and are not guaranteed JEM safety.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: A wall catch requires the native Gouge action/state event; holding a pickaxe is not evidence. Durability, grip and fall-damage formulas must be inspected in installed source/config.

observations.title: Leave a wall hang deliberately

observations.outcome: The player kicks away from the wall.

observations.title: Improve wall-hanging equipment
observations.player_action: Inspect pickaxe tier and the advertised Grip/Momentum enchantments.
observations.outcome: Higher tiers are described as holding longer with lower durability drain; Grip extends holding and Momentum reduces post-slip cooldown.
